item.title: 62 Reade Street by ODA

The apartment project unites industrial loft character with Italianate limestone facades, turning a former clock factory into six expansive homes with tailored finishes. item.title: Ayoughi House: Classical Garden Living for a Multigenerational Family
item.description: Ayoughi House unfolds in a park-like garden in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, where Philipp Architekten BDA choreographs architecture, interiors, and landscape as one coherent whole. This house for an architect and her family grows from its historic park setting, threading living rooms, a planted atrium, and generous garden terraces into a calm yet animated rhythm. Across its rooms, everyday routines meet clear structure, and the result feels measured rather than grand. Read more ...Related:G+B Res

item.title: Itaca House by Studio Strato
item.description: Itaca House reimagines a Roman apartment as a villa-scaled house in the city, crafted by Studio Strato in Rome, Italy. Walls retreat in favor of stepped levels, cabinets, and glass, so each room reads clearly yet stays visually connected. The project threads everyday family life through a central square core, where living, dining, and quiet corners unfold in a continuous, light-washed sequence. item.title: New retro’: Color and Light Shape a Vivid Neapolitan Home

Inside this elevated home, color, gloss, and tactility steer everyday life while wide sliders open the rooms to a sweeping terrace facing Vesuvio. item.title: Soft & Minimal: Calm Terrazzo Living in a Refined Urban Apartment
item.description: Soft & Minimal refines a 130 sqm apartment in Ramat HaSharon, Israel with a quiet, monochrome palette. Designed by Shira Lavi BD, the home strips away partitions to form an open, balanced interior where terrazzo, brushed aluminum, and oak veneer anchor daily life. Calm furniture arrangements and carefully placed art keep the rooms light on visual noise while still feeling tailored and livable. Designed by Salvatore Puleo as a contemporary house, the project replaces an old rural building with a residence that commands views of the coast, the Acitrezza stacks, and Mount Etna. It reads as both lookout and dwelling, grounded in the volcanic terrain around it. item.description: The Cornwall Retreat sits above Porthcothan Bay, a clifftop house by De Rosee Sa in London, United Kingdom, shaped around a young family of surfers. item.title: Dunelands Residence — Coastal Wellness Retreat Shaped by Wind Alone

item.title: G+B Residence by DESK architectes
item.description: G+B Residence sits in Eastman, Canada, where DESK architectes translates a wooded plot into a luminous vacation house for a recently retired couple and their family.
